messages:
Anna: Proposal: simplify pricing tiers — merge Performance+ and Surge into a single 'Performance' tier and introduce an optional 'throughput cushion' add-on billed as rolling credits. Posting a short matrix below; thoughts?

Mike: Quick Q — how do we handle existing Performance+ customers? Migration window + credits conversion?

Anna: Migrate over 6 months, convert remaining burst credits to cushion credits 1:1, prorated for partial months. No forced downgrade during window. Need legal + finance signoff on language.

Dinesh: How does 'cushion' differ from current burstpack? Cushion sounds like continuous billing vs one-off packs. Clarify usage model.

Anna: Exactly. Cushion = a rolling hourly buffer that auto-replenishes. Billed monthly as $ per 1k cushion tokens. Designed for steady headroom rather than ad-hoc spikes.

Priya: Concern: measuring a "cushion token" is tricky. Is it token-equivalent, request-equivalent, or weighted? We should map to normalized token units.

Anna: Agree. Plan is to map to normalized token units (generation tokens + embedding weight). We'll publish a conversion table and examples.

Zac: Enterprise ask — what about existing committed throughput contracts? They need predictability and lower unit price.

Mike: We keep Dedicated/reserved capacity unchanged. For hosted: offer a "Committed Throughput" SLA that purchases cushion at a discount + term (6/12/24 mo), with rollover rules.

Legal-bot: Flag: migration comms must disclose rounding rules, conversion ratios, and how prorates are calculated. Also include change-of-terms lead time.

Anna: Noted. Proposed launch criteria: pilot with 3 customers (one SMB, two mid-market), 2 weeks of stable traffic under new billing, and <3% increase in support volume related to billing.

Priya: Add technical gating: run evals to ensure quantization/autoscaling changes for Performance tier don't affect output quality for the pilot prompt set. Also run cost sims.

Dinesh: I'll run cost sims for 3 workload profiles (chat low-temp, bulk embeddings, short-sequence rerank) and post delta to current per-token cost by EOD Friday.

Anna: :thumbsup: I'll draft a customer-facing FAQ + migration playbook. @Mike please coordinate with legal & finance on contract text and revenue recognition approach.

Mike: On it. Looping in finance. @Zac can you identify two pilot customers?

Zac: Yep — will ping two mid-market accounts and one SMB that already use Performance+.

Priya: One more ask — add a telemetry signal for "cushion burn rate" per route so CS can observe and alert customers proactively.

Anna: Good call. We'll add a dashboard card and alert recipe.

Mike: OK next steps: Anna drafts comms + FAQ, Dinesh posts sims, Priya defines measurement + evals, Mike legal/finance sync, Zac pilot recruitment. Check back next Tue for decisions.
